scope: Offline report validation, not new inference or production acceptance

checks: Historical rates, input size and context preserved without substitution
Missing configurations and failed attempts retained
Hardware identity matches the recorded RTX 3090 platform
Unique IDs and valid configuration references
Recorded weight and build hashes preserved
HTML embeds the same complete dataset as JSON
JSON and measurement CSV byte-identical to the previous publication
English research narrative with separate measurement explorer and technical appendix
Privacy-marker scan; selected-field export excludes raw conversations and audio

features: English report as the default view
Separate data explorer and technical appendix
Curated figures linked to exact source records
Responsive report, explorer and appendix without horizontal page overflow

limits: Publication checks do not turn capped speed tests, failed quality tests or unaccepted microphone tests into PASS. Original private payloads are not redistributed.
